card.name: Linking word after exposure-and-outcome subject
card.fires_on: The verb or 'and' that follows a subject naming an exposure or condition (such as NSAID treatment, alcohol consumption, vitamin D insufficiency), just before the outcome or risk is stated. Seen in study findings.

modes.label: Verb after exposure subject
modes.description: 'was' or 'were' right after a subject describing a patient group or condition, before the finding.
modes.example: patients treated with NSAIDs in the post-MI period<< were>> at increased risk of reinfarction

modes.label: 'and' between exposure and risk
modes.description: 'and' joining an exposure to 'the risk of' in a study title.
modes.example: A meta-analysis of alcohol consumption<< and>> the risk of 15 diseases.

card.plain: It marks the small word that comes after a cause or exposure, just before the text says what happened or what the risk was.
